description: Expected validation outcomes for each test vector in 02_REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTATION/test_vectors/. A conforming UBVM implementation must produce these results.

V-01_valid_capsule.json.note: A valid CC3 capsule with a registered primitive and correct hash. Must be accepted.

V-02_tampered_intent.json.note: The intent.declared field has been modified without recomputing the hash. Must be rejected at Stage 2.

V-03_scope_mismatch.json.note: Capsule is scoped to forge-storage-01. When submitted to test-node, must be rejected at Stage 3.

V-04_containment_violation.json.note: CC4 capsule requesting GENERATE_TEXT (min_class CC2). Must be rejected at Stage 4.

V-05_unregistered_primitive.json.note: UNREGISTERED_PRIMITIVE_FOO is not in the core dispatch table. Must be rejected at Stage 5.

V-06_expired_capsule.json.note: Capsule expiry is 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z, which is in the past. Must be rejected at Stage 6.

V-07_duplicate_capsule.json.note: Same capsule_id as V-01. First execution must be accepted. Second must be rejected at Stage 7.
